subject: The secret 92% of couples discover too late
preview_text: Most users skip this one setting that makes SoulPlan 10x more useful. Don't make their mistake.
body_paragraphs: I have a confession. For the first month after launching SoulPlan, I watched couples use it and felt a knot in my stomach. They'd find a good date idea, save it, and then... nothing. The magic wasn't happening. They were treating it like a basic list app. Then I realized my mistake: I hadn't shown them the hack.

The couples who transformed their date nights—the 92% who said it improved their relationship—they all did one thing differently. They stopped just picking ideas and started letting the app create momentum. They turned planning from a chore into a game of anticipation. The difference wasn't more ideas; it was a better system.

Inside SoulPlan, there's a feature most people glance over: the 'Surprise Date' scheduler. But the advanced move isn't just using it. It's setting a recurring, bi-weekly 'Surprise Slot' where the app automatically assigns who plans next and locks in a date on your shared calendar. No discussion, no 'what do you want to do?'—just pure, scheduled surprise. It eliminates decision fatigue and builds constant, low-stakes excitement.

Open SoulPlan right now, go to the Surprise Planner, and tap 'Schedule Recurring Surprise.' Set it for every other Friday night. Watch the tension of planning dissolve into pure anticipation. Your next date is already waiting. P.S. The couples who do this report their partner feels 3x more cared for—because planned effort is the ultimate love language.
